title: 🪑 Event Seating Planner
description: Seat guests at tables for a wedding, party or dinner: households stay together, people you name are kept apart, and friends are seated together where possible. Your list never leaves the browser.

inputs.name: event-seating-planner-tables-input
inputs.label: Table sizes — e.g. “8, 8, 10” or “5x8” for five tables of eight

inputs.name: event-seating-planner-guests
inputs.label: Guests — one household or group per line; names on the same line always sit together

inputs.name: event-seating-planner-apart
inputs.label: Keep apart — one pair per line: Name / Name

inputs.name: event-seating-planner-near
inputs.label: Seat together if possible — Name / Name

formula: Interactive browser tool — no single closed-form formula (see description).
